notes.title: 🎉 Great news! Our game now has a Steam page!
notes.content:
We are excited to announce that you can now visit our game’s page on Steam and discover everything we have been working on.

⭐ Visit our page here: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3255330/Parasomnia_No_REM/

We invite you to add it to your Wishlist to stay updated on our progress and release. Your support is invaluable as we continue developing the full experience.

✨ Try the Demo: We have also released a Demo on Itch.io. We invite you to try it out and share your feedback with us. We would love to know what you think!

[list]
[*] [url=https://belsgames.itch.io/parasomnia-no-rem]Demo on Itch.io[/url]
[/list]
💖 Support us: If you like what you see, consider supporting us on Patreon to receive exclusive updates and sneak peeks. Every contribution helps us continue developing and improving the game!

[list]
[*] [url=https://patreon.com/belsgames?utm_medium=clipboard_copy&utm_source=copyLink&utm_campaign=creatorshare_fan&utm_content=join_link]Support us on Patreon![/url]
[/list]
🤝 Join our community: Don’t forget to join our Discord server. There, you can share your thoughts about the game, chat with the developers, and be part of our growing community.

[list]
[*] [url=https://discord.gg/RXgmJeR2nQ]Join our Discord Community![/url]
[/list]
Thank you for your support!
This is just the beginning 👁.

- BELS Games Team.
